About MBT

Building Intelligent Systems
for a Digital Future

MUGOBYTE TECHNOLOGIES is a modern technology company focused on intelligent digital solutions for businesses, organizations, farmers, and traders across Kenya and beyond.

MBT develops secure, scalable, and high-performance systems hosted on MBT-owned infrastructure to ensure reliability, speed, uptime, and security. Every product we build is engineered with longevity and growth in mind.

Founded by Eugene Mugo, MUGOBYTE TECHNOLOGIES emerged from a passion for technology and a deep understanding of the challenges faced by businesses in Kenya. We recognized that many local businesses lacked access to affordable, world-class software systems — so we built them.

Today, MBT operates across multiple domains — web development, cloud hosting, AI systems, farm management, and automated trading technologies — each crafted with precision and powered by modern innovation.

Trading Strategies

Multi-Strategy AI Engine

📈

Trend Following

Identifies and rides strong market trends using moving averages, MACD, and momentum indicators to capture sustained market moves.

⚡

Scalping

High-frequency short-term trades that capture small price movements rapidly. Optimized for low-spread markets with tight execution.

🔄

Mean Reversion

Capitalizes on price deviations from statistical averages, entering positions when assets are statistically overbought or oversold.

🌊

Swing Trading

Medium-term position trading capturing price swings over hours or days using support/resistance levels and pattern recognition.

🚀

Momentum Trading

Enters positions aligned with strong price momentum, riding breakouts and continuation patterns with smart position sizing.

📊

Volatility Analysis

Uses ATR, Bollinger Bands, and volatility metrics to adapt strategy selection based on current market conditions.

⚙️ Core Bot Features

  • ✓AI-powered real-time market analysis engine
  • ✓Automated trade execution — no manual intervention needed
  • ✓Smart stop-loss and take-profit management
  • ✓Portfolio risk management and position sizing
  • ✓Real-time performance dashboards and analytics
  • ✓Phone notifications for trades, alerts, and reports
  • ✓Cloud-hosted on MBT secure infrastructure
  • ✓Multi-asset and multi-strategy simultaneous operation
  • ✓24/7 operation — monitors markets around the clock
  • ✓Detailed trade logs and performance history

Trading financial instruments involves substantial risk of loss. Past performance does not guarantee future results. Eugene Mugo is a passionate technology innovator and the founder of MUGOBYTE TECHNOLOGIES. With a deep love for software development, artificial intelligence, and digital systems, Eugene built MBT with a single mission: to make world-class technology accessible to businesses in Kenya and across Africa.

As a self-driven developer and technology enthusiast, Eugene brings hands-on expertise across web development, AI systems, cloud infrastructure, and automated trading technologies. He personally developed the MBT AI Trading Bot — a testament to his deep understanding of both programming and financial markets.

Beyond technology, Eugene serves as a Technician at Edmus Organisation and contributes as an Author at gocrossway.org — reflecting a multifaceted professional who brings leadership, discipline, and vision to everything he does. Frequently Asked Questions

How long does a website take to build?⌄
Most standard websites are completed within 7–14 days. Complex web applications, e-commerce sites, or custom systems may take 3–6 weeks depending on features and requirements.
Does MBT provide hosting for all projects?⌄
Yes! MBT provides fully managed hosting on our own infrastructure for all client websites and systems. This ensures maximum performance, security, and reliability with 99.9% uptime.
Is the MBT POS System available for small shops?⌄
Absolutely! The MBT POS System is designed to work for businesses of all sizes — from small kiosks and shops to large supermarkets and wholesale businesses. Pricing is flexible to match your scale.
How does MBT support clients after delivery?⌄
MBT provides ongoing technical support Monday–Saturday. All hosted projects include server monitoring, security updates, and bug fixes. Premium support packages with faster response times are also available.
